At 0:03.00 the same cup instead contains a single plain silver/white disc sitting lower in the cup. No hand reaches into or touches the center cup during this interval (the hands are working the front-left cup), so the coin stack changes identity, color and quantity with no causal action.

At 0:09.00 four cups are visible in the group (rear, left, front-center, front-right). From 0:09.25 through 0:09.75 only three cups are visible; the near hand rests empty on the felt and the far hand is holding a coin, and no hand lifts or moves a cup away. Partial occlusion from the camera move is possible, but the remaining cups are clearly separated, so a cup appears to vanish.
